response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.entrystat, e.ambictemp, e.imgcount FROM scanenvironment AS e JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref WHERE s.entrystat IS NOT NULL) SELECT entrystat, AVG(ambictemp) AS avg_ambient_temperature, AVG(imgcount) AS avg_image_count, AVG(imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM matched) AS image_count_vs_overall FROM matched GROUP BY entrystat ORDER BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: The overall image-count average covers environment records matched to sites, including records whose temperature is missing. Each AVG ignores null values in its own column; records with no access status are excluded.
